parties: Neelamalai Agro Industries Limited (acquirer) and AVT Natural Products Limited (target)
headline: Neelamalai Agro Industries files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in AVT Natural Products Limited
sum: Neelamalai Agro Industries Limited submitted a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in AVT Natural Products Limited. The filing to NSE marks the formal regulatory notification stage of the transaction.
implication: A Regulation 31(4) disclosure must be filed within two trading days of a public announcement of a substantial acquisition offer; this filing confirms the transaction has entered the public disclosure phase and triggers mandatory public shareholder protections under the SEBI Takeover Code.
detail: Under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, an acquirer making or proposing to make a substantial acquisition (typically ≥25% of voting capital) must file a disclosure with the stock exchange within the prescribed period. This filing by Neelamalai Agro Industries to the NSE indicates a takeover of AVT Natural Products Limited is in progress. The specific consideration, stake percentage, and deal structure are contained in the filed disclosure document (Regulation 31(4) form).
